description: Several bright plastic dishes and utensils are spread on the tabletop, including a red plate in the center, a blue and yellow plate to the left, green and blue cutlery in the middle, and a yellow bottle with a green oval plate to the right. The left hand lifts and steadies the red plate as a left-hand object while the right hand presses a blue sponge cloth as a right-hand object against the plate’s surface, scrubbing in small circular and back-and-forth motions; the plate is tilted and slightly rotated in the left hand so the right hand can wipe along the rim and center, then the plate is briefly presented face-on before scrubbing continues.
